topic: bounded primary-source and theory review of low-cost deterministic CAQ repair or certification

review_contract.inclusion_rule: Include a source only when it directly defines the CAQ objective, solves the equivalent scaled-codebook problem, supplies the exact event baseline, or occupies coordinated local direction rounding.
excluded: generic neural-network quantization without a scale or directional rounding connection
generic fractional programming not needed for the specialized proof
query-time ANNS methods that do not change encoding

sources.title: SAQ: Pushing the Limits of Vector Quantization through Code Adjustment and Dimension Segmentation
sources.finding: CAQ uses finite cyclic single-coordinate code adjustment for the cosine objective; the paper states that this procedure need not reach the global codeword.

sources.title: Practical and Asymptotically Optimal Quantization of High-Dimensional Vectors in Euclidean Space for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
sources.review_depth: full arXiv HTML, proof appendix, and pinned official encoder source
sources.finding: Its scale-rounding lemma and critical-event enumeration already solve the complete normalized-grid direction problem in O(D 2^B log D). The official fast implementation uses a bounded n_enum=10 window and failed this repository's separate exact-parity contract.

sources.title: RaBitQ: Quantizing High-Dimensional Vectors with a Theoretical Error Bound for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
sources.finding: Supplies the nearest-codeword-based estimator guarantee inherited by E-RaBitQ and conditionally claimed by CAQ.

sources.title: Optimal Quantization Using Scaled Codebook
sources.finding: Directly solves the equivalent joint scale and scalar-code assignment MSE problem, characterizes local fixed points, explains alternating-optimization failure, and gives a globally exact O(NK log K) event algorithm.

sources.title: Coordinate Descent Algorithms
sources.finding: Establishes coordinate and block-coordinate optimization as mature primitives; generic coordinated local search is not a novelty claim.

sources.title: LSQ++: Lower Running Time and Higher Recall in Multi-Codebook Quantization
sources.finding: Makes local-search encoding and explicit accuracy-versus-encoding-runtime comparison established practice in vector quantization.

sources.title: DiaQ: Direction-aware Activation Quantization for Fast and Accurate Model Inference
sources.finding: Explicitly formulates cosine-aware choice over a floor/ceil hypercube but uses per-coordinate angular and positional scores with extension and balancing hyperparameters rather than an exact shared-scale Cartesian-shell optimizer.

sources.title: CO-0 v2 B1 Registered Limitation Evidence
sources.finding: Establishes an SAQ-amplified coordinate-local optimization limitation and a 272.9x exact-label cost, while leaving benchmark queries unread.
